summary: God spoke the Ten Commandments to His people from Mount Sinai: ten good rules for loving God and loving others, later written on tablets of stone.

story_reel.narration: From the top of Mount Sinai, God spoke to all His people. He began, 'I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of slavery.' God had rescued them first. Now He was showing them how to live as His free people. Then He gave them Ten Commandments. The first four are about loving God. One: You shall have no other gods before Me. Two: Don't make idols to worship. Three: Don't misuse God's name. Four: Remember the Sabbath day and keep it holy. The last six are about loving other people. Five: Honor your father and your mother. Six: Don't murder. Seven: Be faithful in marriage. Eight: Don't steal. Nine: Don't lie about others. Ten: Don't covet, which means don't be jealous of what belongs to someone else. Later, God wrote these commandments on two tablets of stone with His own finger. God's commands aren't meant to take away our fun. They're like guardrails on a mountain road, keeping us safe and showing us how to love God and love others well.

scenes.caption: Rescued first

scenes.art_direction: A winding mountain road with guardrails keeping a happy family safe.

memory_verse.text: You shall have no other gods before me.

identity_focus.core_truth: Yahweh's commands show me how to love Him and love others well.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: God's commandments help us love God and others. Which commandment do you think is easiest for you to keep? Which is hardest?

quiz.question: What did God remind His people of before giving the commandments?
options: That He rescued them from slavery in Egypt
quiz.explanation: God said, 'I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.'

quiz.question: What is the first commandment?
options: You shall have no other gods before me
quiz.explanation: The first commandment is, 'You shall have no other gods before me.'

quiz.question: Which commandment comes with a promise?
options: Honor your father and your mother
quiz.explanation: 'Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land.'

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, thank You for rescuing me and showing me how to live. Help me put You first and love others well. Your ways are good! Amen.

companion.message: Hearing God's voice from the mountain was overwhelming! But His words were good. They showed us how free people love God and each other.
